[[Lushivahr the Invoker]] is a [[Margonite]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Yatendi Canyons]].

== Locations ==
* [[Vabbi]]
** {{NPC location|Yatendi Canyons}}

== Skills ==
20 Water Magic in Hard Mode.
* {{skill icon|Air Attunement}}
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Chilling Winds}}
* {{skill icon|Freezing Gust}}
* {{skill icon|Invoke Lightning}} ([[elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Lushivahr's Prism]] ([[unique]])
* [[Margonite Armor]]
* [[Margonite Mask]]

== Notes ==
* [[Elementalist]]s [[Signet of Capture|capping]] the skill may wish to bring a second Signet of Capture, as an [[Hajok Earthguardian (Insect)|Elementalist boss]] with [[Master of Magic]] is along the way.
* This boss deals heavy damage in [[Hard mode]]. Consider bringing damage reduction skills such as [[Protective Spirit]] or [["Save Yourselves!"]], or caster shutdown methods in form of [[interrupt]]s or [[dazed]]. Spreading out before engaging Lushivahr will also prevent Invoke Lightning from hitting multiple party members.
